Resolves #21894

A TaskStore can derive a phase’s dates and completion from its leaves. Set `rollupParents: true` on the store. A chart edit plans the leaf, its structural ancestors and reachable dependency successors before publishing one row batch. Other charts borrowing the plan observe the same values. The default continues to use stored parent dates.

The exhibition example opens with three phases and twelve tasks. Delay the lighting and Prepare gallery grows from November 9–15 to November 9–18, keeping its duration-weighted 45% progress. Folding the phase leaves its span visible.

Evidence: L3 (two-chart Store observers, outgoing FS cascade, calendar transition and Chromium journeys at desktop and phone widths) → L3 required. AC-7 remains open for the gallery record and deployed launch. Emmy owns that work on [#21934](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21934#issuecomment-7080717900) after the landing-frame producer in #21908.

## Deltas from ticket

Chart edits publish the task, phases and successors in one row batch. Adds, removes, reparents and reloads settle ancestors in a follow-up `updateRows` pass after the structural `mutate` or `load` event (`onRollupMutation` → `rollupParentTasks`).

The public store policy follows the ticket author's amended contract. Direct record writes refresh derived phases; scheduling a dependency successor remains an operation of the chart's scheduling writer. A derived phase supplies its own dates, so newly drawn dependency links target leaves. Interactive cycle admission also considers the child-to-parent relationship. Duration weighting uses elapsed leaf time. Empty phases retain their stored values.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #21894 (its Fix and Avoided Traps: the store owns the policy, not a view; off by default), the changed-file list, `dev`'s `src/gantt/TaskStore.mjs`, `Cascade.mjs` and `Container.mjs`, the split catalog on `dev` (`apps/portal/resources/data/examples/`, `example-captures.json` families), and `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs:170`.
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** A reactive opt-in config on `Neo.gantt.TaskStore`, false by default. With it on, the store is the only writer of a parent's start, end and percent: the envelope of its children, and the duration-weighted mean of its leaves. The roll-up is planned inside the same batch as the edit, and a changed phase feeds the dependency cascade again. A derived phase refuses drag and resize in every chart. It must not live in a view config or the example controller. Test isolation: unit specs on the store with the policy on and off, plus a two-chart case.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches. `rollupParents_` (`src/gantt/TaskStore.mjs:44`) with `isDerivedParent` (:59-61) as the single predicate. `writeRows` appends ancestors' derived values to the same batch. `runDependencyCascade` stages writes in a `pending` Map and adds the child→parent edge, so a phase's outgoing finish-to-start link reads the new finish (pinned by `Cascade.spec.mjs` "a phase and its outgoing successor settle in the same store batch across two charts"). The example only sets `rollupParents: true` and moves a task through `gantt.moveTask`, with no summing of its own.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with verify-before-assert: the ticket's first prescription (a view config) was dropped after Emmy's preflight showed two fixtures breaking, and the implementation follows the amended, store-owned contract.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: A phase that holds only zero-duration work reads 0 %, whatever its children say. `planParentRollup` writes `percentDone: total.weight ? total.completed / total.weight : 0` (`src/gantt/TaskStore.mjs`, in `planParentRollup`). Milestones are zero-duration tasks, so with #21937's milestones a phase of completed milestones would show 0 %. The config doc covers the edge only obliquely ("Zero-duration work has no weight; an empty phase keeps its stored values"). Not blocking. Worth one decision before milestones land: keep the stored percent when the weight is 0, or say 0 % in the doc.
- **Second edge, not blocking:** `#summary` and `derivedFields` read `startDate`, `endDate` and `percentDone` by name. `Neo.scheduler.Container` exposes `startDateField`, `endDateField` and `percentDoneField` (`src/scheduler/Container.mjs:86-98`), so a chart mapping other fields onto a roll-up store would derive nothing, silently. One sentence in the Gantt guide's roll-up section would cover it.
